text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen, the
race that
determines the spring King of
the Mile...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The rain is really coming down today!
The track is
completely soaked.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I think this might be too much for Taiki
Shuttle to
handle.

There's a lot of concern brewing around
whether
Taiki Shuttle can perform well
in these conditions.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the weather's not looking so hot
today. Gray
skies and not a lick o'
sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I ain't bothered one bit! I'm ready
for
anything, come hell or high water!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My heart's burnin' so hot, that rain'll turn
straight
into steam around me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I tell ya what! I'm gonna show the crowd
some real
good runnin' to get 'em all
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It'll take more than a few raindrops to
dampen my
power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I will! Make sure ya root me on!
